程序包 org.bukkit

枚举类 Effect

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<Effect>
org.bukkit.Effect
所有已实现的接口:
Serializable, Comparable<Effect>, Constable
public enum Effect extends Enum<Effect>
A list of effects that the server is able to send to players. 服务器能够发送给玩家的效果列表。
